# pve_containers (Data Source)

Lists the LXC containers on one node as reported by `GET /nodes/{node}/lxc`. Only containers the credentials may audit (`VM.Audit` on `/vms/<vmid>`) are returned. Configuration keys the provider models elsewhere are not part of this index; unmodeled upstream fields are not surfaced.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

# LXC containers on node pve1.
data "pve_containers" "pve1" {
  node = "pve1"
}

output "running_container_ids" {
  value = [
    for ct in data.pve_containers.pve1.containers : ct.vmid if ct.status == "running"
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node whose containers to list.

### Read-Only

- `containers` (Attributes List) Containers on the node, ordered as PVE reports them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--containers))
- `id` (String) Identifier of the listing; equals the queried `node`.

<a id="nestedatt--containers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `containers`

Read-Only:

- `cpu` (Number) Current CPU usage (fraction); null for stopped containers.
- `cpus` (Number) Maximum usable CPUs.
- `disk` (Number) Root disk image space usage in bytes.
- `diskread` (Number) Bytes the guest read from its block devices since start; not available for all storage types.
- `diskwrite` (Number) Bytes the guest wrote to its block devices since start; not available for all storage types.
- `lock` (String) Current config lock, if any; null when unlocked.
- `maxdisk` (Number) Root disk image size in bytes.
- `maxmem` (Number) Maximum memory in bytes.
- `maxswap` (Number) Maximum SWAP memory in bytes.
- `mem` (Number) Currently used memory in bytes.
- `name` (String) Container name; null when the node does not report it.
- `netin` (Number) Traffic in bytes sent to the guest over the network since start.
- `netout` (Number) Traffic in bytes sent from the guest over the network since start.
- `pressure_cpu_some` (Number) CPU Some pressure stall average over the last 10 seconds.
- `pressure_io_full` (Number) IO Full pressure stall average over the last 10 seconds.
- `pressure_io_some` (Number) IO Some pressure stall average over the last 10 seconds.
- `pressure_memory_full` (Number) Memory Full pressure stall average over the last 10 seconds.
- `pressure_memory_some` (Number) Memory Some pressure stall average over the last 10 seconds.
- `status` (String) LXC container status: `stopped` or `running`.
- `tags` (String) Current configured tags, if any.
- `template` (Boolean) Determines if the guest is a template; false when absent.
- `uptime` (Number) Uptime in seconds.
- `vmid` (Number) The (unique) ID of the container.
